title: Singleton Influence Sample Count
statement: For a dimension $n\in\mathbb{N}$, a positive rational influence bound $t$, and a rational learning parameter $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$, define the singleton influence sample count to be the Fourier estimator sample count at accuracy prescribed by $t$ and $\varepsilon$, and confidence prescribed by $n$.
caveat: The referenced accuracy, confidence, and Fourier estimator sample-count definitions are not included, so their exact mathematical formulas cannot be rendered.
